scope: Bounded recovery probe for the two annotated list witnesses cited by DCP-LETT-2186. Public Cambridge manuscript images were located and preserved additively; no rows are admitted, reconstructed, or added to accepted evidence.

public_sources.finding: CUL-DAR160.151 is catalogued as Bentham George to Darwin Charles Robert, [1857.12.16--1857.12.17], Calendar 2186; the public record has no image/transcription link itself.
Manifest exposes canvases labelled 151:1r through 151:4v and their public image services.

mapping_and_recovery.physical_image_mapping: Preserved image 151-2r.jpg (IIIF canvas label 151:2r, canvas 620). The upper-left pencil folio mark visibly reads 151/1; this is the Cucubalus list leaf, despite the IIIF canvas label 151:2r.
mapping_and_recovery.visual_finding: The damaged leaf visibly contains a numbered Cucubalus pair list, at least rows (1) through (8), with male/female symbols and Bentham annotations/comments in a right-hand column. Torn and abraded areas remove portions of several rows. The image proves the cited annotated list survives publicly, but is not a safe basis for a complete textual row transcription without specialist manuscript work.

companion_blank.observation: Largely damaged/blank reverse, no recoverable list rows.

mapping_and_recovery.physical_image_mapping: Preserved image 151-4r.jpg (IIIF canvas label 151:4r, canvas 624). The upper-left pencil folio mark visibly reads 151/3; this is the Silene list/annotation leaf, despite the IIIF canvas label 151:4r.
mapping_and_recovery.visual_finding: The damaged leaf visibly contains a Silene heading/list area, several ruled or bracketed blank entry lines, male/female symbols, and Bentham handwritten annotations. Legible fragments include “S. ... noctiflora!” and a bracketed note containing “Cucubalus”/“Behen”; damage and loss prevent a trustworthy complete transcription. Do not turn these fragments into normalized species rows.

companion_blank.observation: Largely damaged/blank reverse, no recoverable list rows.

additional_images_checked.observation: Bentham letter page, not the cited list leaf; body text corresponds DCP-LETT-2186.
Small damaged handwritten fragment; no reliable list rows.

historical_boundaries: DCP-LETT-2186 explicitly says “I return the lists”; accepted decision links the surviving cover to 2184 and 2177 while holding the annotated lists absent from the DCP transcription.

The recovered images establish actual manuscript/list survival and can support future visual transcription, but do not establish any exact receipt date beyond the accepted December 16/17 incoming alternative and 18 December response context.
Bentham annotations and Darwin list text are mixed physical layers; source authorship must not be collapsed into a single voice.

No complete textual transcription was located in the public sources checked. The positive image recovery supersedes a claim that the leaves are globally unavailable, while row-level content remains a bounded visual-retrieval gap.
candidate_use: Candidate supplemental visual-source pointer only. Root may decide whether to attach these image hashes/locators to the existing scoped relationships; do not create new rows or replace the accepted unavailable-list limitation.
non_actions: No accepted primary note, decision, ledger, raw projection, graph, transcript, or export was modified.
